## Outcome

I addressed review across three PRs, mostly by removing unrelated setup, strengthening assertions, and making user-facing changes clearer.

## Context

PRs #288 and #286 began before GSoC, while #336 began in Week 2. This week records the specific review revisions rather than claiming their entire implementation.

## What I Did

- Revised [PR #288](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/288): removed an unrelated change, removed skips that hid behavior, strengthened custom-height assertions, and used named theme-height values.
- Revised [PR #336](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/336): stripped the parameter before variant validation, renamed unclear objects, preserved coverage for `FALSE` and default `TRUE`, and guarded against partial matching.
- Revised [PR #286](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/286): removed redundant numeric checks and rewrote NEWS around user-visible positive `panel.margin` support.

## Learnings

Review often improves a change by deleting code. A strong test states a layout relationship rather than inspecting an incidental helper type. A strong changelog describes what users can rely on rather than what test file changed.

## Challenges / Notes

The branches needed to preserve their test-first history while presenting the final problem and solution without every temporary experiment.

## Next Week Targets

Finish the panel-margin merge and continue collaborative `coord_equal` work for non-square viewports.
